transcript.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
transcript.text: Let’s slow down for a moment. I’m hearing a lot of frustration about last quarter, and some of us haven’t shared yet. Before we choose a lead or a pitch, can we hear from those who haven’t spoken? I think fresh perspectives might help us see options we’ve missed.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: There are a few of us who haven’t said much yet. Would anyone like to jump in? It might help to hear a fresh take before we make a call.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: Maybe it’s worth checking—are we all clear on what we want to present as our main value? I feel like we might be skipping over some details that could matter.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: I’ve been listening, and I think what sets us apart is how we actually follow through with support after onboarding. Maybe we can focus the pitch on that? Also, just to be clear, who’s actually taking the lead if we go that route?

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: I think Lucía's point about our support after onboarding is important. We actually stick with clients longer than most. Have we looked at the numbers to back that up? And about the lead—maybe someone who's worked closest with those clients should take it.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Do we know exactly how many clients stayed with us beyond the initial onboarding? I think that could make our pitch stronger if we have the numbers.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: I think Lucía and Lilian are right—our ongoing support is a strong point, but do we actually have those retention numbers handy? And if we're going that route, maybe Fatima should lead since she’s worked closest with those clients?

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: I agree support after onboarding is something we do well, but does anyone have the actual retention stats in front of them? I'd feel better pitching it if we can point to real numbers. And Fatima's got the most direct experience with those clients—makes sense if she takes the lead.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: I don't have the retention stats in front of me either, but I think our support after onboarding really does make a difference. If Fatima's okay with it, she'd make sense as the lead for this pitch.

transcript.name: Park Jae-Won
transcript.text: We’ve heard enough. Retention after onboarding is our angle. Fatima, you’ll present. I expect those client numbers on my desk within the hour. Anyone disagree? Speak now or move on.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: No objections here. Just want to make sure we all get those numbers before the pitch—otherwise, sounds good to me.

transcript.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
transcript.text: Alright, I’ll take the lead on this. To be completely clear—does anyone have the retention numbers on hand right now? If not, I’ll track them down and circulate them within the hour, so no one’s left in the dark before the pitch. If anyone has concerns about this approach or anything else, let’s get it out now.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: I don't have the numbers here, but once you send them, I can double-check for accuracy if that's helpful. Just want to make sure we've got everything covered.

transcript.name: Park Jae-Won
transcript.text: Fatima, you circulate the retention numbers. Wei, verify them—quietly. No more group debate about process. We’re out of time. Anyone who can’t keep up should say so now.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Just let us know once the numbers are around. I think it’s the right focus—we just need to be sure about what we’re promising.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: I’m good with the plan. Just flag me when the retention figures are ready, please—I want to double-check our source matches what’s in the report.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Just flag me too when the numbers are sent, please. I think we’re all set on the plan—just want to make sure there’s no confusion about who’s sending or checking what.

transcript.name: Park Jae-Won
transcript.text: I’ve heard enough. Fatima, send the numbers. Wei, check them quietly—no group emails. Everyone else—wait for instructions. If this takes longer than an hour, I’ll step in myself. Understood?

transcript.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
transcript.text: I’ll get the retention numbers out in the next thirty minutes and let Wei know directly for double-checking. If anyone needs anything else, flag it to me now—otherwise, I’m on it.
